articles.title: 11 Things People in Healthy Relationships Say to Each Other
articles.summary: No one teaches you how to talk to your partner. You pick it up as you go—sometimes by watching your family members, sometimes by saying the wrong thing and wishing you could rewind. But listen to people in healthy relationships, and certain kinds of words come up again and again: the ones that show appreciation, make room for a bad day, or let someone know they don’t have to hide the messy parts of being human. “Sometimes people just want to feel seen,” says Stephanie Michaelian, a Los Angeles-based therapist. articles.title: Jensen Huang and the Cult of the Male Tech Founder
articles.summary: Even by Silicon Valley's standards, Jensen Huang’s scandals were outlandish. Huang resigned two weeks ago following reports that he had an affair with tech executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy whose company was suspected of steering restricted advanced AI chips to the country. He has also reportedly engaged in at least two other affairs with subordinates at Nvidi a and was known for belittling those who worked under him. articles.title: Mamdani Unveils Plan to Close Infamous Rikers Island, Replace It With ‘Borough-Based Jails’ by 2032. How Would It Work?
articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has announced plans to shut down the city’s Rikers Island jail complex in 2032 after a century in operation, setting an end date for a site that has long been infamous for persistent violence and abuse. In its place, the city is set to open “borough-based” jails in four of its five boroughs : Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx.
